words.example: Today the new clerk will shadow the supervisor at registration.
words.exampleZh: 今天新文员会在挂号处跟主管见习。

words.example: Cross-train the clerks so any of them can cover another counter.
words.exampleZh: 请交叉培训这些文员，让他们谁都能顶另一个柜台。

words.example: This short course will upskill the night team on the roster tool.
words.exampleZh: 这门短课会帮助夜班组提升使用排班工具的技能。

words.example: Finish the knowledge transfer before our senior clerk retires in June.
words.exampleZh: 请在资深文员六月退休之前完成知识交接。

words.example: Desk-side support sits with registration for the whole first morning.
words.exampleZh: 上线后的第一个上午，工位旁支持会全程陪在挂号处。

words.example: A service account lock stopped the interface from logging on at 03:00.
words.exampleZh: 服务账号锁定让接口在凌晨三点登不上。

words.example: The interface account needs logon as service or it cannot start after a reboot.
words.exampleZh: 接口账号得有作为服务登录的权限，否则重启后起不来。

words.example: Interactive logon is denied for service accounts, so use a personal admin instead.
words.exampleZh: 服务账号不允许交互登录，请改用个人的管理员账号。

words.example: A network logon from the interface host failed because the account was locked.
words.exampleZh: 接口主机发起的网络登录失败了，因为账号处于锁定。

words.example: Cached logon let her into the laptop on the ward, even though the domain was unreachable.
words.exampleZh: 域已经连不上，缓存登录仍让她进了病区那台笔记本。
